name: Canva
tagline: Design, asset, export, and collaboration APIs.
shortDescription: Canva Connect APIs let apps create integrations for assets, designs, comments, folders, exports, and brand workflows.
agentSummary: Agents can use Canva APIs and the Canva MCP server for design creation, editing, asset search, export, commenting, and brand workflows.
bestFor: Design asset sync, generated design workflows, comments, and export automation.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Public integrations need Canva review; brand assets and design mutations require approval. Verify official docs, pricing, rate limits, permissions, and production side effects before delegating account-changing actions to an agent. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Public Canva pricing; API integration access may depend on use case and plan.
authModel: OAuth, Canva app/integration credentials, and Canva MCP per-user authentication.
accountCreation: Self-serve user/team signup; developer app review for public integrations.
browserSupport: Browser UI remains central for design review and editing.

capabilities.detail: Canva Connect APIs expose assets, designs, comments, folders, and exports with OpenAPI.
Canva provides a remote MCP server for design creation/editing, asset and brand management, library search, export, and comments.
Docs include Connect API, apps SDK, app components, and review rules.
Public Canva pricing; API integration access may depend on use case and plan.
Self-serve user/team signup; developer app review for public integrations.
Design creation and review are browser-first workflows.
